image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a worn baseball resting on a textured wooden surface. The ball features the characteristic white leather cover with prominent red stitching in a figure-eight pattern. The surface shows signs of use, including scuff marks and dirt stains. A portion of a brown leather glove or mitt is visible in the upper right corner, partially obscuring the ball.
